Goals: To avoid dehydration where fluids are restricted.
Actions: Increase intake during periods of high heat/humidity and/or nausea/vomiting.
Be aware of dehydration risk towards end-of-life.

Goals: To be able to prevent malnutrition and know how to eat healthily.
Avoid excessive salt intake (>5 g/day) and maintain a healthy body weight.
Actions: Discuss current food intake, role of salt, and role of micronutrients.
Discuss need for supplementing in case of nutrient deficiencies; note there is no clear role for routine micronutrient supplementation.
Discuss maintaining a healthy body weight.
Notes: Reference to routine micronutrient supplementation not supported by clear role.

Goals: To be able to abstain from or avoid excessive alcohol intake, especially for alcohol-induced cardiomyopathy (CMP).
To restrict alcohol according to cardiovascular (CV) prevention guidelines.
Actions: Tailor alcohol advice to aetiology of heart failure (HF); e.g., abstinence in alcoholic CMP.
Inform and discuss alcohol intake according to CV prevention guidelines (2 units per day in men or 1 unit per day in women).

Goals: To be aware of the need for immunization for influenza and pneumococcal disease.
Actions: Discuss benefits and possible barriers to immunization.

Goals: To be aware of the consequences for health of smoking and use of recreational drugs.
Stop smoking (including e-cigarettes) and stop taking recreational drugs.
Actions: Inform, discuss and help in decision making about smoking cessation and drug use.
Refer for specialist advice for smoking cessation and drug withdrawal and replacement therapy.
Consider referral for cognitive behavioural therapy and psychological support if patient wishes to stop smoking or taking drugs.

Goals: To be able to prepare travel and leisure activities according to physical capacity.
To be able to take an informed decision about driving.
Actions: Inform and discuss practical issues related to long haul travel, staying abroad, exposure to sun (amiodarone effects), high humidity or heat (dehydration), and high altitude (oxygenation).
Provide practical advice related to travel with medication/devices (keep medicines in hand luggage, have a list with medication, device name/card and treating centres).
Inform about local/national/international regulation related to driving.
